title: News Shock
briefing: A shock is coming for the whole market. Some businesses will shrug it off; others will not. Everyone gets the same headlines at the same time.
objective: After a market-wide shock, tell temporary damage from lasting damage and move toward the businesses that hold up.
debrief: A sudden banking scare on day 9 knocked every stock down at the open. Orchard Foods recovered within days because people still buy groceries; Kestrel Air kept falling as travel bookings were canceled. The central bank's support on day 15 lifted the market, but the airline recovered only part of its loss. A disciplined player avoided panic-selling the defensive stock, did not buy the airline's first bounce and kept size moderate.
